name: The Grounds — 200 Acres
body:
Mountain-backed. Tree-flanked. Theirs alone. Two hundred acres of Southern Woods land six miles from Fairbrooks' centre — close enough to breathe the city, far enough to claim peace.

NOT A SINGLE SOUL OUTSIDE THE FOUND FAMILY SETS FOOT ON IT. The property stretches deep, mountains rising at the far boundary, trees thickening into forest on the flanks, and the only road in winds through a canopy that closes overhead like the land itself is keeping secrets.

THE SOIL IS OLD MAGIC and it responds to intention. That is not decoration. That is the reason the house has the shape it has.
